_comment: Shape the drafting agent writes in step 3. Every suggestion must cite at least one sampled session id in 'sessions' and carry a non-empty 'diff' (unified diff for an edit; full content as an addition for a new skill) — score_aggregator.py rejects anything less. An empty suggestions list is a valid, reportable success.

suggestions.change: Rewrite the trigger description so the skill fires on 'deploy', 'release', and 'ship' — it currently triggers only on 'deployment checklist'.
suggestions.evidence: In 0f3a2b1c-example-claude-session the user asked to 'deploy the staging build'; the skill never fired and the agent reconstructed the checklist from memory, missing the migration step.
suggestions.diff:
--- a/SKILL.md
+++ b/SKILL.md
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 ---
 name: deploy-checklist
-description: Walk the deployment checklist.
+description: Use when the user asks to deploy, release, or ship a build — walks the pre-deploy checklist including migrations and rollback tags.
 ---
